story_title: Lina and Adams and the Fruit Picnic
lesson: Learn fruit and food words in English!
title: Lina and Adams and the Fruit Picnic 🍌🍎 | Learn Fruit Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Lina and Adams pack a picnic full of yummy fruit! 🍌🍎🍊
In this English story for kids, children learn 7 new words: picnic, hungry, banana, apple, orange, share and full. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🧺 picnic — نزهة — pique-nique
😋 hungry — جائع — avoir faim
🍌 banana — موزة — banane
🍎 apple — تفاحة — pomme
🍊 orange — برتقالة — orange
🤝 share — يتقاسم — partager
😊 full — شبعان — rassasié

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: pause after each new word and ask your child to say it out loud. You can also name the fruit in your kitchen together! Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

lines.text: It is a bright Saturday morning.
Adams, it is a beautiful day. Let's have a picnic!
A picnic? Yes! I love picnics!
A picnic is when we eat food outside, in a park or a garden.
Can you say it with me? Picnic!
Milo the cat wants to come to the picnic too. Meow!
Lina and Adams put food in the picnic basket.
Let's take some fruit. Fruit is good for us!
I will bring the sandwiches and some water.
They put in a banana, an apple and an orange.
One, two, three fruits. Our basket is ready!
Off they go to the park!
At the park, Lina and Adams play and run and jump.
They play for a long, long time.
Oh, my tummy is making a noise. Grrr!
You are hungry, Adams! I am hungry too.
When we want to eat, we say: I am hungry.
Say it with me: hungry!
Lina opens the basket. What does she see first?
A banana! It is long and yellow.
Monkeys love bananas. Ooh, ooh, ah, ah!
Lina and Adams laugh.
A banana is a long, yellow fruit. We peel it before we eat it.
Say it with me: banana!
Next, Adams takes out something round and red.
I have an apple! It is red and shiny.
Apples are crunchy. Crunch, crunch!
An apple is a round fruit. It can be red, green or yellow.
Can you say it? Apple!
Mmm, my apple is sweet!
There is one more fruit in the basket.
It is an orange! The orange is orange, like its name.
An orange, orange fruit! That is funny!
An orange is a round fruit with juice inside. It is very juicy.
Say it with me: orange!
Oh! Who is that? It is Milo the cat. He followed them to the park!
Milo looks at the sandwich. Meow, meow!
Milo is hungry too. Can we give him a little piece?
Yes, let's share. Sharing is kind.
When we give some of our things to a friend, we share.
Say it with me: share!
Milo is so happy. Purr, purr.
Now the basket is empty. All the food is gone.
I ate so much. My tummy is full!
My tummy is full too. I can't eat any more.
When we have eaten enough, we say: I am full.
Can you say it? Full!
The sun is going down. It is time to go home.
At home, Lina and Adams talk about their day.
We had a picnic. We were hungry, so we ate a banana, an apple and an orange.
And we shared with Milo. Then we were full!
Can we have another picnic next week?
Yes! With more fruit!
Good night, Lina. Good night, Adams. Good night, Milo.
